svg.text: Notes
Fields stack in one column, Method right above Check # or note, as Mercury's Mark as paid does.
Laptop: the dialog sizes to its content, here its 320 minimum; Cancel and the primary bottom right; Esc and Cmd+Enter work.
Tablet 768: the same 320 dialog at touch sizes (44px fields, 16px text); Cancel stays beside the primary from md.
Phone 375 and 320: bottom sheet, one full-width Mark paid · $850.00 (194px in a 288 column at 320), the X closes it.
Method and the calendar open as a popover with a mouse and on a tablet, and as a view inside the sheet on a phone.
Paid on is today: 11/21/2026 typed with a mouse, Nov 21, 2026 on touch. No quick picks, so backdating takes the calendar.
The toast rides 16px above the ActionBar at every size. At 320 phoneMessage keeps one line: Paid · Zack gets an email.
Other toast details: Zack's emails are off, Zack has no email. History gets the Paid email only once it sends.
FormSheet focuses the first empty field on open, here Check # or note; on Android that can raise the keyboard.
The page behind is screen 2's To pay and Paid (03-invoice-page.svg); the chrome is app-shell.tsx as it renders today.
Refs: HoneyBook Mark as paid (total in the button), Mercury Mark as paid (Paid on over Payment method).
